primary.title: Does trading more actually help? SEBI’s data says no
primary.summary: On 20 August 2026, SEBI published two studies covering FY25 and FY26. One measured whether individual traders in the equity derivatives segment made or lost money. The other looked at how they actually traded — their frequency, their strategies, their costs, and who they were.
